svg.text: Solid: magnification factor for ζ = 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 (peak falls as damping rises)
Dashed purple: transmissibility for ζ = 0.25. All transmissibility curves pass through (√2, 1)
Isolation requires r > √2; more damping helps near resonance but hurts at high r
Resonance: ω = ωn , amplitude limited only by damping
